title: Missing timeouts on LocalAPI I/O operations
description:
whois() and status() have no timeout on UnixStream::connect(), http1::handshake(), or send_request(). If tailscaled hangs, every auth call blocks indefinitely, exhausting tokio worker threads and hanging kithd.

Fix: wrap each I/O stage in tokio::time::timeout() with e.g. 5s deadline. Return WhoIsFailed("LocalAPI timeout") on expiry.

Files: crates/kith-tslocal/src/lib.rs, both whois() and status()
